newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends down, seen in narrow range.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends down, seen in narrow range.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices ended down after drfiting narrowly due to year-end factors. Dec 1-10 palm oil exports figure of 203,000 tonnes had no impact, as it was within estimates. Actiivty was confined to switching from spot Dec to Jan/Feb.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Lack of tenders also eased the market which followed the futures sector. Interest was seen among crude palm oil and selected refined products.
Morning prices drifted in a tight seven-ringgit range. "I think the tight movements will continue until the release of the PORLA data next week," a trader said.

The Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) will release the November palm oil exports/stock/output data on December 16. Crop forecaster Ivan Wong will release his latest November crop data on Friday.
At the close, the February futures contract was down six ringgit at 1,184 ringgit ($469.19) a tonne.
Among physicals, Dec (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,210 ringgit after trading at 1,210 and 1,207.50. Bids for Dec (south) was 1,205.
Dec (central) saw offers at 1,200 and bids at 1,190, and Dec (north) at 1,187.50 against 1,182.50.
Jan (south) saw offers at 1,215 and bids at 1,210 with earlier trades at 1,210 and 1,212.50. Feb (south) was offered at 1,215 and bids at 1,210.
Among refined products, Dec RBD palm oil was offered at $517.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, and Jan/Feb/Mar at $510.
Dec RBD palm olein saw offers at $557.50, Jan at $550 and Feb/Mar at $545. Dec was traded at $555.
Dec RBD palm stearin was offered at $372.50, Jan at $375 and Feb/Mar at $380. Dec/Jan palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $290.
